Efficient volumetric clouds - Resources - three.js forum
Blue noise is intrinsically tileable and easier to blur-out than white noise. This lib provides a bunch of pre-computed blue-noise textures: GitHub - Calinou/free-blue-noise-textures: Free 2D, 3D and 4D blue noise textures from the Moments in Graphics blog Limit number of samples For the samples towards the light, I use a linear scale.
